turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How short should I cut the lawn? I just bought a new mower and I'm itching to use it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For most garden lawns, around four or five centimetres is a happy height. Going shorter tends to stress the grass.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, here it is again. For most garden lawns, around four or five centimetres is a happy height. Going shorter tends to stress the grass.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My neighbour cuts his like a golf course.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It looks sharp, but very short grass dries out faster and lets moss and weeds in. His probably needs a lot more feeding and watering.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, he is always out there with a sprinkler. How often should I mow?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: In spring and early summer, about once a week. The rule of thumb is never cut off more than a third of the height at once.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Raise the blades and mow less. Taller grass shades its own roots and stays greener.
